items.text: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling underwent ankle surgery (deltoid); expected out ~10 weeks / IR. Jake Tonges (MCL) out for season after surgery. Beneficiaries include Deebo Samuel.
items.why: Deltoid rupture repaired surgically; Tonges season-ending MCL. Confirmed via Shanahan/Rapoport/Schefter.
items.implication: Deebo/Evans/Robinson/Hodge elevated permanently short-term; Deebo top waiver per Berry/ETR. Kittle/CMC unaffected.
items.opportunity: Stribling was projected significant role; vacuum for veterans.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring during Wednesday's practice (Houston Chronicle). Missed five games due to a hammy pull back in 2024. Crucial MRI results coming (hopefully) tomorrow. WR routes run last week on 42 CJ Stroud dropbacks: 1. Nico Collins 37 2. Xavier Hutchinson 29 3. Kayshon Boutte 27 4. Jaylin Noel 15 5. Jared Wayne 8.
items.why: High route share + prior multi-week hamstring absence raises re-aggravation/miss risk; MRI key.
items.implication: If out or limited, Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel/Schultz rise in target share; Collins owners need contingency.

items.text: I'm not saying it's likely but as I said in the preseason many times.... #1 RB in fantasy football is within the range of outcomes for Kenneth Walker.
items.why: Preseason belief + Week 1 workhorse usage validates massive upside with Chiefs.
items.implication: Start with extreme confidence; hold/trade as top asset. Aligns with Levitan opportunity data.
items.opportunity: Confirmed high snap/opp/route/target share in KC debut.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow told reporters he is dealing with back tightness and didn’t practice today. He got plenty of mental reps and expects to play Sunday. Status worth watching.
items.why: Back tightness/soreness post-Week 1; limited/DNP-ish Wednesday (mental reps); insists he will play, calls sitting 'ridiculous'.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday practice; history of injuries elevates caution but self-report strong for active. Chase/Higgins/Brown unaffected if he plays.
items.opportunity: Full starter snaps expected if active.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in today’s practice, an indication he could return on Sunday.
items.why: Full participant Wednesday after ankle issue kept him out Week 1; progressive return.
items.implication: Likely active Week 2 vs PIT in timeshare with Stevenson; FLEX upside, reduces Stevenson pure volume.
items.opportunity: Explosive change-of-pace/complementary role expected on return.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice today due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring issue post-MNF; estimated DNP/limited on short week.
items.implication: Monitor rest of week; if limited/out, more work for J.K. Dobbins and depth. Short week elevates risk.
items.opportunity: Committee back; any absence boosts Dobbins.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week.
items.why: Stribling long-term absence + Week 1 production elevates Deebo in 49ers offense.
items.implication: Priority add in leagues where available; aligns with ETR injury-beneficiary list.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets expected with Stribling out ~10 weeks.

items.text: Early Week 2 Injury Report for Waivers: Ladd McConkey = Tre’ Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane = Rashod Bateman; A.J. Brown = Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De’Zhaun Stribling = Deebo Samuel/Demarcus Robinson; Alvin Kamara = Kendre Miller; plus streamers and FAAB notes.
items.why: Precise injury-beneficiary mapping from Week 1 absences/injuries for waiver priority.
items.implication: Target listed beneficiaries (Deebo top-tier); drop list and streamers (Wentz etc.) provided.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups/handcuffs on outs.

items.text: As expected, Kenneth Walker went to KC to be a true workhorse. Last night: Handled 29 of the first 32 RB opportunities; Ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks; Tied for team-high with 6 targets for a 22% share; 23-173-1 rushing, 3-18-1 receiving result. He fucks.
items.why: Near-monopoly on early RB opps + high routes/targets in debut confirms three-down role with Mahomes.
items.implication: Elite RB1 upside ROS; handcuff irrelevant short-term. Berry concurs range includes overall RB1.
items.opportunity: 29/32 early opps, 19 routes/33 dropbacks, 6 targets (22% share), dual-threat production.

items.text: Seahawks ruling out Sam Darnold for Sunday’s game against the Arizona Cardinals (glute), but HC Mike Macdonald saying there are no plans to place their quarterback on injured reserve.
items.why: Glute injury; ruled out Week 2, no IR planned (short-term).
items.implication: Drew Lock or backup starts; impacts SEA pass-catchers (JSN etc.) volume/efficiency short-term.

items.text: First Rest Of Season Rankings show live with Adam Levitan et al.: discussing CMC, Travis Etienne, Rashee Rice, Ashton Jeanty, Jalen Coker and more post-Week 1 opportunity adjustments.
items.why: Opportunity-based ROS Top-150 adjustments after Week 1 usage/injuries.
items.implication: CMC/Etienne/Rice/Jeanty elevated or affirmed in hierarchy; use for trades.

items.text: Rashee Rice has a tiny career average depth of target of 4.9 yards. Last night was 2.5 yards. Rice needs serious volume to pay off in box score. The two targets for a 7% share last night are notable. Routes were there though. On 33 Mahomes dropbacks: 1. Xavier Worthy 30 2. Rashee Rice 29 3. Tyquan Thornton 24.
items.why: High routes but low aDOT + only 2 targets (7% share) in return; volume-dependent profile.
items.implication: Still rosterable for routes/role but needs target spike; ETR ROS still high on him. Worthy lead routes.
